Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) vs Apple (AAPL): on the same formula, their operating margins are 22.3 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AMD: $34.6B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — AMD: +34.3% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — AMD: 10.7% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — AMD: 12.5% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — AMD: 19.4% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AMD: 20.5% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: AMD Dec 27, 2025 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
